messages.author: 4753f061948056b3
messages.subject: Shiny-server give output code different than shiny libarary in local
parts:
Hi, Sorry if that problem has already been pointing out elsewhere in the mailing list, if serached for but didn't found an explanation.

I have build a Shiny app, and have setted up the open source shiny-server on my own private debian web server.

I am quite surprised to see that the shiny-server ouput html code is not the same taht i have in local with shiny using Rstudio.
Shiny server seem to embed quite all ui.R html tags in q supplementary div witch broke all of the CSS stuffs that i have setup.

Is it normal ?

Can i disable this behavior ?

Thanks for explanaitions,

grégoire

parts:
Sorry, hit send accidentally. Shiny 0.11 had a number of changes that were quite substantial, including a move to bootstrap 3 (as 2 has long since stopped being supported). Some notes on migration here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/upgrade-0.11.html

We are very sorry for the inconvenience, we don't take it lightly when we change the html but sometimes it is necessary.

parts:
Hi Joe,

I'm sorry i should have check versions before asking. Quite common error, sorry for that.
Local : R 3.0.2 + Shiny 0.10.2.1
Server : R 3.2.0 +Shiny 0.11.1

So i have to update my local installation to be compatible with the server one, and as it's the way that shiny evolve, i will change all my apps (BIG work, because some are quite complex, but that's life ...).
Don't be sorry, a software as shiny have to evolve, and we have to adapt ourselves. I'm quite confident in the fact that i you made that choice it means you had to.

Thanks a lot,

Grégoire
